Phone controlPhone navigationScreen control

Docs/Connectors/Phone navigation

Phone navigation

Goes back and home, opens recents, scrolls, locks the screen and takes screenshots.

Group
Phone control
Needs
Accessibility access. A settings screen opens when you add it.
Runs on
Your phone
Privacy
It does not read the screen.
Default
Off until you add it in the app

Lets Ultron operate other apps through Android accessibility. It can tap, type and read the screen, so turn it on only if you understand that.

Tools

Ultron picks the right tool from what you say, so you never have to name one. The phrases are only examples.

  • Back button

    press_back

    Press the Back button.

    Say: Back jao, phir home screen.

  • Recent apps

    open_recent_apps

    Open the recent apps screen.

    Say: Recent apps dikhao.

  • Previous app

    switch_to_previous_app

    Switch back to the app used before this one.

    Say: Pichli app par wapas jao.

  • Notification shade

    open_notification_shade

    Pull down the notification panel.

    Say: Notification panel neeche kheencho.

  • Quick settings

    open_quick_settings

    Open the quick settings panel (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth tiles).

    Say: Quick settings kholo.

  • Scroll

    scroll_screen

    Scroll or swipe the screen up, down, left or right.

    Say: Thoda neeche scroll karo.

  • Lock screen

    lock_screen

    Lock the phone.

    Say: Phone lock kar do.

  • Screenshot

    take_screenshot

    Take a screenshot (saved in the gallery).

    Say: Screenshot le lo.

  • Go to home screen

    go_to_home_screen

    Leave the current app and show the home screen.

    Say: Home screen par chalo.

  • Power menu

    open_power_menu

    Open the power off and restart menu.

    Say: Power menu kholo.

  • Split screen

    toggle_split_screen

    Turn split screen on or off.

    Say: Split screen on karo.
